title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples; docs quickstart and site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR introduces a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and a concise quickstart for the docs site. Motivation: make it fast for developers to onboard to agent-based workflows with Redwood by providing vetted templates that wire up retrievers, CCs, and tool endpoints (search, SQL, HTTP tool) and demonstrate tool-calling patterns in both the SDKs and the docs site. The change set includes: 1) example agent templates (python + typescript) for common RAG patterns (browser-search + vectorstore, SQL-tool + verifier, multi-tool orchestration); 2) tool-calling examples showing structured tool outputs, explicit schemas, and fallback behavior; 3) a short docs quickstart page with runnable snippets and a reproducible sample app in redwood-examples/playgrounds; 4) small docs-site layout updates to surface agent quickstarts in the getting-started nav. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and tests - [x] Add SDK usage examples (py/ts) - [x] Docs quickstart + runnable examples - [x] CI green for unit+doc build - [x] Reviews addressed Notes: kept templates intentionally minimal and documented tradeoffs (synchronous vs async retrieval, caching KV strategies, safety checks). Related: ENG-4821 tracks templates ownership; DOC-204 requests docs quickstart. No breaking API changes. Followups: add additional language examples and an expanded playbook of eval prompts in a subsequent PR.
